items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I got hip to Dexter Gordon... I’d be listening to... and then I’d be playing Dexter Gordon

ctx.x: Yeah, early Brubeck. I was probably ten. And I listened to Brubeck and I was taking guitar lessons, and I think I bought — I didn’t buy it, my parents bought it for me because I wanted it — the “Time Out” album. And I had no idea what they were doing time-wise. I couldn’t — it was brand new to me. And then the next album I got ahold of was Thelonious Monk. So he played in four. But that was a whole ‘nother thing too. So that’s © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
kind of where it started and I got hip to Dexter Gordon, Charlie Parker, Lambert, Hendricks & Ross and Joe Williams and on and on and on.
